subject: [hw] DONE DEC06 rev 6 (numbers only): malformed-input sweep added; N2TEST DEC06 PASS 2553/2553
body:
DONE DEC06 rev 6. Supersedes rev 5 (no product change; test coverage only, so the board number matches the tree).

  bash gpu/hwcodec/vt/dec/run_tests.sh
  N2TEST DEC06 PASS 2553/2553
  (rev 5 was 2533; +20 = 5 vectors x 2 builds x 2 new checks.)

New: a deterministic robustness sweep in every t_nal build - 2000 random/truncated avcC/hvcC records, SPS buffers and length-prefixed samples per codec, fed to n2vtd_avcc_parse/hvcc_parse, n2vtd_sps_parse, n2vtd_sample_to_annexb and n2vtd_annexb_find_params under ASan+UBSan; malformed input must return an error or be rejected and never read out of bounds. No product change.

Everything else from rev 5 stands (the full-range OPEN fix, MM21 always, analyzer fixes). Not done list unchanged: no phone run; MM21 not phone-verified; crop origin 0; 10-bit/non-4:2:0 per-frame refusal; in-band parameter changes; CPU copy; -12782 properties; emit under the mutex. Files: vt/dec/test/t_nal.c, vt/dec/STATUS.md, dsh-state/workers/DEC06/STATUS.md.
